answer: Sybil resistance comes from a locked performance bond rather than identity. An agent deposits collateral to earn one attestation slot; duplicate or lying slots trigger slashing, so the bond is forfeited. A raven scout spots reused keys, a lotus stake stays frozen across settlement, and with each tide of challenges the cost compounds: an attacker needing 100 fake voters must post 100 separate bonds, and one caught cheat destroys the entire pool.
